_about: Every fish in the game so far, easiest first. A fish's fight is one or more sections; each section is one fight-box mode (an id from fight_modes.json) with a difficulty range [from, to] on the 0 (easy) .. 1 (hard) scale. 'curve' says how difficulty moves through a section as its meter fills: 'climb' rises from 'from' to 'to'; 'bell' rises to 'to' halfway and eases back to 'from'. 'rules' apply to every fish: each fight starts at 'start'; a finished section hands the next one a head start of up to 'carry_max', scaled by how well it was played (accuracy above 'carry_threshold'). Names follow the two-language rule (see CLAUDE.md); Sanbi is canon. 'pearls' is the reward range [min, max]. See docs/white-paper/06-fish-fights.md.
_about_rewards: What a catch earns. Quality: a roll of 0..1, plus 'quality_per_streak' for every catch already in the streak, plus up to 'quality_accuracy' for accuracy above 50%; the whole part picks a tier (capped at the last). Size: rolled in the fish's 'size_cm' range, pushed toward the top by 'size_per_streak' per streak catch. Pearls: rolled in the fish's range, times the tier's 'quality_pearls' multiplier, plus 'pearls_per_streak' per streak catch (capped at 'pearls_streak_cap').

fish.name: Karkoi
fish.description: A lazy pond fish. It drifts about and gives up quickly.

fish.name: Bagnazu
fish.description: A heavy bottom-feeder. Reel it up, then keep up as it wanders.

fish.name: Magatum
fish.description: Fast and strong, but it burns out: each stage of the fight peaks in the middle. Set the hook, survive its runs, then match its tail beat.

fish.name: Sanbi
fish.description: Placeholder fight for the canon fish. Ignore its decoys, hold steady, and keep going when you lose sight of it.
